usage.finalMessage:
I added the `move` command, listed it in `help` right after `cancel`, and committed the work with the report. A move is checked against the same rules as a new booking (booking window and one appointment per slot) and gives the same errors. All 7 tests in `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` pass, including the ones I added showing that a refused move changes nothing.
Open questions in the report: the slot rule lets clinician k2 have more than one appointment per slot, but no decision record or approval allows that. Also, moving an appointment to its current date and time is refused.

OUTCOME: completed
